mails.subject: Sponsoring your Friday community lunches?
mails.body:
Hello,

I am the community manager at Bryggeriet Nord, a small independent brewery that makes alcohol-free drinks. We have been reading about your Friday community lunches and would like to sponsor them for the autumn.

What we have in mind: we supply drinks for each lunch from October to December, and in return you mention us on your event pages and put a small sign on the lunch table. We can also send someone from the team to say a few words once, if you would like that.

Would you be open to a short call to see if this fits? I am available most weekdays after lunch.

Best regards,
Gustav Holmgren
Bryggeriet Nord
mails.justification: An organisation proposes sponsoring community lunches in exchange for a mention, so partnership, no fixed date, answer within the week.

mails.subject: Kan ikke komme ind i bygningen
mails.body:
Hej,

Mit adgangskort virker ikke i aften. Jeg står ved hoveddøren, og læseren blinker rødt. Jeg skal aflevere et tilbud i morgen tidlig og har min computer og alle mine papirer inde på kontoret.

Kan en af jer låse mig ind, eller give mig en kode til sidedøren? Jeg kan blive stående ved indgangen i en halv time.

Mvh
Jesper Kjær
mails.justification: A member is locked out late in the evening with work needed tomorrow, so complaint at maximum urgency, reply needed.

mails.subject: Duplicate charge on my invoice, EUR 180
mails.body:
Hello,

I believe I was charged twice for the meeting room I used on 8 October. My bank statement shows two payments of EUR 180 on 9 October, but your invoice 2026-0412 only lists one.

Could you check this and refund the second payment, or tell me if I am missing something? I would also like my company VAT number (DK 23456789) on a corrected invoice.

Thank you,
Isabelle Moreau
mails.justification: A member asks about a possible duplicate charge and a VAT number on the invoice, so billing, 24-hour urgency, reply needed.

mails.subject: Notice of scheduled maintenance of the parcel locker, 14 October
mails.body:
Dear customer,

We would like to inform you that the parcel locker installed at your address (Locker ID 4471) will be taken out of service for scheduled maintenance on Wednesday 14 October 2026, between 08:00 and 12:00.

During this period, parcels addressed to the locker will be redirected to the nearest alternative pickup point, located at the kiosk on Havnegade 12. Recipients will receive a separate notification with the new pickup point and a new access code.

Parcels already stored in the locker before the maintenance window remain available until 07:30 on the same day. We recommend that you collect any parcel before this time.

The maintenance is expected to improve the reliability of the door mechanism and to update the software of the touch screen. No action is required from your side.

This message is sent automatically to all registered customers of the Kolliboks service. Please do not reply to this address.

Yours faithfully,
Kolliboks Customer Operations
mails.justification: An automatic service notice from a parcel locker service in use, so newsletter category, informational, no reply needed.

mails.subject: Re: great night! 🎉
mails.body:
Hey you two! 👋

Just a quick one to say thanks again for hosting our little game jam last weekend, it went way better than I expected. We ended up with 12 finished prototypes and everyone was still smiling on Sunday evening 😄. A few people already asked if we can come back next year!

FYI, I put the photos in the shared folder, feel free to use any of them on your site or socials, I do not need credit.

Also, I finally subscribed to your monthly newsletter, the last issue had that tip about the quiet room schedule and I loved it, I will be using it from now on 🙌.

Nothing to do on your side, no need to answer! Just wanted you to know.

Hugs,
Niko

> On 19 Oct, Sofia wrote: Hope you all had fun, the room is yours whenever you want to come back.
mails.justification: A casual thank-you and FYI after an event, mentioning the newsletter in passing, so other, nothing to act on, no reply.

mails.subject: Hot desk for a freelancer, and a trial day?
mails.body:
Hello,

I am a freelance illustrator and I am looking for a place to work three days a week. A colleague of mine is a member of your space and recommended it.

Could you tell me what a hot desk costs per month, and if there are desks available from November? I would also love to try the space for a day before deciding. Is that possible, and does it cost anything?

By the way, I subscribed to your newsletter last week and the autumn programme looks great, so I think I would fit in well.

Thank you,
Anna Lindqvist
mails.justification: A visitor asks about hot desk prices, availability and a trial day, with a passing newsletter mention, so membership, within the week.

mails.subject: pausing my membership?
mails.body:
Hi,

I wanted to ask about my membership. I have been at the flex desk since March and I love the place, but from December I will be working abroad for about four months, for a project in Lisbon, and it feels silly to pay for a desk I cant use.

Is it possible to pause the membership for those months and then restart in April? Or would you rather I cancel completely and sign up again later? I dont mind either way, I just dont want to loose my place in the community and the lockers.

I think my notice period is one month, but im not sure, I could not find the terms in the welcome email. Could you also tell me what happens to the 400 DKK deposit if I stop?

If pausing is not an option, please tell me how to give notice properly, and by which date I need to do it so I am not charged for December.

Thanks a lot and sorry for the long message,
Tobias

Sent from my phone
mails.justification: A member asks how to pause or give notice on the membership and about notice terms, so membership, answer within the week, reply needed.
